items.definition:
the arrangement of the natural and artificial physical features of an area
The topography of the region was very mountainous.

the action of taking up or absorbing something
The new students showed a quick uptake of the material.

a place or position affording a good view of something
From our vantage point on the hill, we could see the entire city.

the willingness to take bold risks
He had the audacity to question the manager's decision.

a V-shaped mark or pattern
The military uniform had a chevron on the sleeve.

a doctor or other health professional who treats patients
The clinician carefully examined the patient's symptoms.

the practice of persuading someone to do something by using force or threats
He claimed he signed the contract under coercion.

the part of the human body between the legs
The pants were torn at the crotch after he fell.

the cosmic law and order, or righteous conduct
In Buddhism, following the Eightfold Path is essential to understanding dharma.

a principle or set of principles laid down by an authority as incontrovertibly true
He challenged the traditional dogma of the scientific community.

a flag or standard, especially a military or naval one; a junior officer rank
The ensign was flying proudly from the mast of the ship.

an obsessive preoccupation or attachment
His fixation on perfection made him a very demanding boss.

the force or energy with which a body moves; the force that makes something happen or happen more quickly
The discovery of new evidence provided fresh impetus to the investigation.

adaptation to a specific place or culture
Software localization is crucial for global markets.

the act of assembling and preparing for active service or use
The mobilization of troops was swift after the declaration of war.

an oxide containing one oxygen atom
Carbon monoxide is a colorless, odorless, and poisonous gas.

an open rebellion against authority
The crew staged a mutiny against the captain.

The power of something to affect the mind or body; strength.
The drug's potency was carefully measured.

The transfer of a business, industry, or service from public to private ownership and control.
The privatization of the railway system led to mixed results.

The action or process of distributing something differently or again, typically to achieve greater social equality.
The government proposed a redistribution of wealth.

The action of withdrawing formally from membership of a federation or body, especially a political state.
The threat of secession loomed over the country.

A hard, unreactive, colorless compound that occurs as the principal constituent of sand and other rocks.
Quartz is a form of silica.

the quality of being sophisticated
Her sophistication was evident in her elegant manners and insightful comments.

a feeling of deep anxiety or dread
Teenagers often experience a lot of angst about their future.

lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern
There was a widespread apathy among the voters, leading to low turnout.

a cause of great distress or annoyance
The noisy neighbors were the bane of his existence.

a house where men can pay to have sex with prostitutes
The police raided the illegal brothel last night.

the deliberate use of artificial methods or other techniques to prevent pregnancy
Access to contraception is a key public health issue.

the highest or climactic point of something, especially as attained after a long time
The award ceremony was the culmination of years of hard work.

the state of being harmed or damaged
Smoking is to the detriment of your health.

the act of spreading something, especially information, widely
The rapid dissemination of news is common in the digital age.

spiral shape
The DNA molecule has a double helix structure.

a reversal of position, order, form, or relationship
The inversion of the normal word order can create emphasis.

the process of bringing a business to an end and distributing its assets
The company went into liquidation after failing to pay its debts.

a distinguished musician, especially a conductor
The orchestra performed beautifully under the baton of the maestro.

the investigation of minute objects and structures through a microscope
Advanced microscopy techniques allow us to see individual cells.

adherence to traditional or accepted creeds
He challenged the orthodoxy of the scientific community.

division into two sharply contrasting groups
The issue caused significant polarization within the community.

money paid for work or a service
The remuneration for the job was excellent.

a compound acting as a neurotransmitter
Serotonin plays a key role in mood regulation.

a person who believes in the superiority of a particular group
The group was led by a white supremacist.

a particular philosophy of life or conception of the world
His worldview was shaped by his travels.

the formation of a number of things into one cluster
Data aggregation is important for analysis.

the opening at the end of the alimentary canal
The anus is part of the digestive system.

the fact or process of ending or being brought to an end
The cessation of hostilities was a welcome relief.

a protein found in skin and connective tissues
Collagen is essential for healthy skin and joints.

lysergic acid diethylamide (a hallucinogenic drug)
LSD is a powerful hallucinogenic drug.

unit of speed equal to the speed of sound
The jet flew at Mach 2.

improper, illegal, or negligent professional activity or treatment
The doctor was sued for medical malpractice.

the study of microscopic organisms
She is studying microbiology at university.

the quality or condition of being modern
The city blends ancient traditions with modernity.

A chemical element with the symbol P.
Phosphorus is an essential element for all living organisms.

A person, especially a young one, endowed with exceptional qualities or abilities.
The young musician was considered a prodigy by the age of ten.

The treatment of mental disorder by psychological rather than medical means.
She decided to try psychotherapy to help manage her anxiety.

An expert in a particular subject or field who is frequently called upon to give opinions about it to the public.
Political pundits are often invited to discuss current events on TV.

A period of government by a regent.
The Regency era in Britain was known for its distinctive architecture and fashion.

a layer or series of layers of rock or earth
Geologists studied the different strata of rock.

a final demand or statement of terms
The company issued an ultimatum to the striking workers.

a disease that withers plants; something that spoils or damages things
The potato blight destroyed the crops.

a flexible tube inserted into the body to withdraw or introduce fluid
The nurse inserted a catheter to drain the fluid.

the art of making motion pictures
The film was praised for its stunning cinematography.

an officer in charge of a particular force or institution
The commandant addressed the new recruits.

a highly poisonous chemical compound
Cyanide is a deadly poison.

a mystery, a puzzle
The disappearance of the plane remains an enigma.
